description: Dimensions of one STAT-TAB table: each variable's code, label, number of values, first values (code + label), which one is time (with range), the default used when unspecified, and the cell count. Pass 'variable' to list (and 'value_filter' to search) all values of one dimension, e.g. to find a commune code. Examples: {table_id:'px-x-0102010000_101'}, {table_id:'px-x-0102010000_101', variable:'Kanton', value_filter:'Bern'}.

lang.description: Language of titles/labels: de, fr, it or en (default en)

table_id.description: Table id like 'px-x-0102010000_101' (or its API path / STAT-TAB URL)

value_filter.description: With 'variable': substring filter on value codes/labels

variable.description: List values of this variable only (code or label)

name: get_bfs_table_metadata
title: Describe a BFS STAT-TAB table
